statement.zh: 南部冲积平原的农业、畜牧及相关手工业须参照具体河流水文与土壤条件理解（Potts 物质基础综合）。
statement.en: Southern alluvial agriculture, animal husbandry, and related crafts must be understood against specific river regimes and soil conditions (Potts).
